subject: PO conditionality: BU code mapping, invoice slicing, and net-term tradeoffs
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@mednova.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@mednova.com
Date: 2026-09-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence for MN enterprise agreement

Hi Chloe / Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is asking for a few specifics before we can issue a formal PO:

- PO line must include BU code and MedNova tax entity (we operate across two bill-to entities).
- Invoices must reference the internal GL tag and the engagement SOW id.
- We prefer weekly micro-invoices for consumption items, but AP will only accept one monthly statement if multiple invoices exceed 25 lines.
- Net terms: our standard is Net60, but we can consider Net45 for SaaS vendors with an early-pay discount.

Attached is our PO template (excel) — can you confirm you can populate BU code + SOW id in the invoice header and whether Redwood can support weekly micro-invoices tied to the same PO? Also: is Redwood willing to offer a 1.5% discount for Net30 payment? Our finance team needs the options documented to move to CFO approval (Anthony).

Appreciate a quick confirm so procurement can prepare the formal purchase order.

Best,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Senior Procurement Manager
MedNova Health

Attachments: MedNova_PO_Template_v3.xlsx

From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@mednova.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for MN enterprise agreement

Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Confirming a few things from Redwood side and proposing trade-offs for speed to contract: 

1) PO header mapping: we can accept the BU code and tax entity in the PO and will populate both on every invoice. We map those to our billing entity and will include the GL tag and SOW id in the invoice reference field.

2) Invoice cadence: our platform supports both models — weekly micro-invoices (consumption line items) AND a monthly statement that aggregates. The limitation is AP system processing: to avoid >25-line rejections we can
   - Offer weekly micro-invoices capped at 20 lines (works for most customers), or
   - Send weekly micro-invoices and a single monthly statement (preferred for your AP) — we mark the statement as the summary invoice and include links to the weekly details.

3) Net terms / discount: We typically price on Net45. For Net30 we can offer a 1.75% early-pay discount (applies to subscription & usage invoices where payment is received within 30 days). For Net60 we can offer no discount but must defer some billing features (e.g., we require PO pre-authorization for usage spikes).

4) SOW / Billing entity: if MedNova will sign a single MSA + SOW per legal entity, we can route invoices to the correct tax entity automatically.

I attached a short supplement (pdf) that documents our PO field mapping and the invoice header template. If Anthony wants to see a sample populated invoice with MedNova fields filled, I can generate one from our billing sandbox — takes an hour.

Next steps: if procurement confirms preferred cadence (weekly micro-invoices with monthly statement OR single monthly aggregated invoice) and Net-term preference, I’ll loop in Finance to lock final discount terms and update the SOW.

Thanks — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_PO_Supplement.pdf

From: Anthony Reynolds <anthony.reynolds@mednova.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, lisa.tran@mednova.com
Date: 2026-09-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for MN enterprise agreement

Chloe / Lisa — quick from finance. We are open to Net45 with a 1% early-pay discount for Net30, but only if Redwood can provide automated invoice metadata (PO, BU code, GL tag) that our ERP can parse. If Redwood requires manual mapping, the discount goes away.

Also, AP will not process statements with >50 line items; weekly micro-invoices are preferred if each remains ≤20 lines. Can Redwood confirm the automated metadata feed (CSV or SFTP) options and whether you can include a machine-readable PO header?

If feasible, proceed with Net45 + 1% Net30 discount conditionally — I will instruct contracting to proceed once we have a technical confirmation.

Thanks,
Anthony Reynolds
VP Finance, MedNova Health

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Anthony Reynolds <anthony.reynolds@mednova.com>, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@mednova.com>
Cc: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-13T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for MN enterprise agreement

Anthony / Lisa — copying technical billing ops answers below. Short answer: yes, we can do an automated metadata feed and machine-readable headers. Details: 

- We can export a daily CSV of invoices to an SFTP endpoint (secure key exchange) with fields: PO_NUMBER, BU_CODE, GL_TAG, SOW_ID, INVOICE_ID, AMOUNT, INVOICE_DATE, LINE_COUNT.
- We also support an API Push to your ERP (we can provide a signed webhook consumer) if MedNova prefers real-time posting.
- For the human-readable invoice, we will include the PO/BU/GL in header and in structured JSON embedded in the invoice PDF metadata.

Operational trade-offs we recommend: weekly micro-invoices (≤20 lines) + a monthly statement that references the weekly invoices. That keeps your AP happy and limits per-invoice processing overhead.

Regarding discount: Redwood accepts the conditional 1% early-pay Net30 discount if the SFTP feed is configured and the PO headers are machine-readable as specified. We will include the discount clause in the billing supplement.

Happy to schedule a 30-minute ops call this week to exchange SFTP credentials and test the CSV payload. What time works?

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@mednova.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Anthony Reynolds <anthony.reynolds@mednova.com>, procurement@mednova.com
Date: 2026-09-14T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for MN enterprise agreement

Thanks — this is great progress. Procurement confirms:

- We will issue a single PO per legal entity and expect weekly micro-invoices (≤20 lines) plus a consolidated monthly statement.
- Net terms: MedNova will accept Net45 with the conditional 1% Net30 early-pay discount (contingent on the SFTP CSV feed with the specified fields).
- Please provide a sample CSV schema and one sample populated invoice (sandbox) by EOD Friday so we can schedule a 30-minute test with our AP integration team.

Once we validate the feed, contracting will issue the PO (deal id MN-2026-0412).

Appreciate the responsiveness — cc'ing procurement for tracking.

Best,
Lisa
Senior Procurement Manager
MedNova Health
